build_MultiInputSequential: build a MultiInputSequential module that chains multiple nn.Modules where the first accepts multiple tensor inputs
create_RemoteSequential: create a RemoteSequential from a list of rpc.RRef objects to wrap remote modules sequentially
add_layer_PipelineModulesGraph: add a RemoteModule layer with specified input sources and optional output count to a PipelineModulesGraph
add_sequence_PipelineModulesGraph: add a sequence of RemoteModules to a PipelineModulesGraph where each module feeds into the next
partition_graph_PipelineModulesGraph: partition a PipelineModulesGraph into device-local sequential groups and return tuples of nodes and remote module references
